info.title: ARTHSAVORA
info.description: Commercial-grade AI-powered financial management ecosystem for India.

get.description:
Returns 200 OK if the Python FastAPI application process is alive.
Fast and non-blocking; does not query downstream databases.

Verifies that critical dependencies (PostgreSQL database) are reachable.
Returns 200 OK when ready to accept traffic; returns 503 Service Unavailable if degraded.

post.description:
Registers a new user in PostgreSQL, initializes default financial preferences,
and provisions their initial personal workspace.

post.summary: Authenticate user with email and password
post.description:
Authenticates email and password credentials.
Throttled to 5 requests per minute per IP to defend against brute-force attacks.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile and settings.

post.summary: Exchange refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Validates refresh token and returns a fresh access token.
Logs out the user and acknowledges session invalidation.

get.summary: Get current user profile and settings
get.description: Retrieves full profile details, financial preferences, and completion status.

patch.summary: Update current user profile and preferences
patch.description:
Updates profile display name, avatar, preferred currency, timezone, and locale.
Rejects unauthorized modifications to server-controlled identity fields.

post.description: Safely marks account as inactive and terminates active sessions.

get.summary: List all accessible workspaces for current user
get.description: Returns all active workspaces the authenticated user belongs to.

schema.title: Response List Workspaces Api V1 Workspaces Get

post.description:
Provisions a new workspace (Personal, Family, or Business) and designates the user as Owner.
Enforces personal workspace uniqueness, business profile capture, and family isolation boundaries.

get.description:
Retrieves workspace details.
Guaranteed to return 404 if the user is not an active member to avoid cross-tenant enumeration.

patch.description: Updates workspace title, default currency, timezone, country, and business profile.

post.description: Places active workspace into read-only ARCHIVED state. Financial mutations are prohibited.

post.summary: Restore archived workspace back to active status
post.description: Restores ARCHIVED workspace back to ACTIVE status.

post.summary: Transfer workspace ownership to another active member
post.description:
Controlled, atomic ownership transfer.
Designates a target active member as OWNER, and updates previous owner to specified role.

get.description: Lists all active members in the specified workspace with profile information.

schema.title: Response List Workspace Members Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Members Get

post.summary: Add an existing registered user directly to the workspace
post.description: Directly attaches a registered user to the workspace. Requires INVITE_MEMBERS permission.

patch.description: Updates a member's role with strict hierarchy validation. Prohibits demoting the owner.

delete.summary: Remove or revoke a workspace member
delete.description:
Revokes access immediately. Requires REMOVE_MEMBERS permission or self-removal.
Prohibits removing the owner. Historical transactions retain actor attribution.

post.summary: Issue a cryptographically signed workspace invitation
post.description:
Generates a secure 32-byte invitation token, stores only its SHA-256 hash,
and returns the one-time raw token to the caller for delivery.

get.description: Lists invitations for the active workspace. Never exposes raw tokens.

schema.title: Response List Invitations Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Invitations Get

post.description: Revokes a pending invitation so it can no longer be accepted.

post.summary: Accept a workspace invitation using raw token
post.description:
Validates token SHA-256 hash, acquires row-level lock, checks expiry and recipient email binding,
and grants the authenticated user membership in the workspace.

post.summary: Create a financial account in current workspace
post.description:
Provisions a normalized financial account:
- Validates account type compatibility for workspace tenancy model (Personal/Family/Business).
- Validates currency using Money domain value object.
- Prevents duplicate linked provider references within the workspace.
- Quantizes opening balance and seeds initial balance snapshot.

patch.description: Updates mutable metadata, credit limits, or notes. Prohibits updating closed or archived accounts.

post.description: Transitions active account into read-only ARCHIVED state while preserving historical reporting.
Restores an ARCHIVED account back to ACTIVE status.
Formally marks account as CLOSED. Validates closing_date >= opening_date.

get.description:
Returns unambiguous balance values:
- Book balance (derived from posted transactions and journals).
- Available balance (reported or calculated).
- Provider-reported balance (with effective timestamp).
- Outstanding liability (credit cards / loans).
- Pending transaction amount.
- Opening balance.
Retrieves point-in-time balance snapshot history in reverse chronological order.
